title: Finalize flips round status to COMPLETE but never persists holdings
expected: Clicking Finalize creates a holding for every founder and persists a captable:holdings key; the holdings table then lists each founder's holding shares (e.g. Alice 302000, Carol 100000).
actual: Started with roundStatus forced to OPEN, reloaded (UI showed 'status: OPEN'), then clicked Finalize. The status flip persisted (captable:roundStatus became "COMPLETE") proving the handler ran and writes work, but NO captable:holdings key was created. Baked localStorage after finalize contained only roundStatus, safeAmount, founders; holdings-table stayed empty ('No holdings persisted'). The terminal action reports success without producing its deliverable.

title: SAFE amount silently truncates the sub-cent tail on the persisted value
expected: amount = shares x price with no silent precision loss. 12345 shares x $0.0001 = 1.2345; the persisted captable:safeAmount should retain the full value (1.2345).
actual: After Compute amount with shares=12345, price=0.0001, the displayed amount was $1.23 and, more importantly, the persisted captable:safeAmount was '1.23' — the sub-cent tail 0.0045 was dropped from the stored authoritative amount. (Clean case 4000000 x 0.001 = 4000 persisted correctly, confirming the loss is precision-specific, not a wrong formula.)

title: Finalize help '?' button throws ReferenceError and shows no help
expected: Clicking the '?' (fin-help) control surfaces the finalize help text.
actual: Clicking '?' produced an uncaught console error 'ReferenceError: undefinedHelpHandler is not defined (index.html:214)' and displayed no help. The help affordance is wired to a non-existent handler and is non-functional.
